Matt — thanks for the checklist and the heads up. Looping in Marissa (Security Controls) and Irene (Ops) so we can coordinate artifacts and the transfer method. High-level reply and plan below.

What we will provide:
- ekm_access_matrix.csv: operator roles, least-privilege mapping, and current operator list (includes role IDs and guardian emails).
- ekm_audit_snippet.pdf: redacted sample of the rotation event log (timestamps, key id, wrapped/unwrapped ops).
- sftp_transfer_manifest.txt: instructions and manifest for how we will place encrypted bundles on your SFTP endpoint (PGP-encrypted tar.gz).
- HSM attestation: if the customer-facing deployment uses a managed HSM we will include the vendor attestation/statement; on hosted tenants we use an EKM connector to a customer EKM or cloud HSM — we will clarify per-tenant topology.

Rotation policy summary (excerpt):
- Data encryption keys (DEKs) are rewrapped daily for long-lived sessions; DEK rotation scheduled automated every 24 hours for persistent volumes where rotation is supported.
- Key-encryption-keys (KEKs) rotation: quarterly by default; emergency rotation playbook exists for compromise scenarios (requires 3-person approval: Ops lead, Security lead, and the on-call manager).
- All key material movement is logged with operator identifier and WORM-backed storage for 12 months (longer retention available on request).

ETA: We can stage an initial package to your SFTP endpoint by Mon, 27 Mar 2028 17:00 PT if you provide the endpoint and PGP public key. Final sanitized rotation logs and vendor attestation can follow by Fri, 31 Mar 2028.

Attachments included in the initial drop: ekm_access_matrix.csv, sftp_transfer_manifest.txt. If you need additional fields in the matrix (e.g., JIRA ids for change tickets), let us know.

Ben
